title: Well-Dressed Couple, 1940s Vintage B&W Snapshot, June 1947
description: A crisp, full-length outdoor portrait of a stylish young couple taken on June 5, 1947. The man is sharply dressed in a double-breasted pinstripe suit with a lapel pin, patterned tie, and pocket square. The woman arm-in-arm with him wears a floral pattern dress, a dark fascinator hat, and white heels while holding a small parcel or purse. They stand on a shaded sidewalk in front of a brick building and lush leafy trees, capturing middle-class American fashion and everyday life in the immediate post-WWII era.
